name: Fairmont Sanya Haitang Bay
positioning: Beachfront Fairmont resort in Haitang Bay, Sanya, with views of WuZhiZhou Island and a Yun River setting
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront resort in Haitang Bay
Families wanting suites with a kids' room
Guests who like a Fairmont Gold lounge and dragon boat arrival

facts.text: The hotel is beachfront, with views across WuZhiZhou Island.
The hotel's address is No. 10 Haitang North Road, Haitang Bay District, Sanya.
The hotel's design uses fine craftsmanship on rare wood.
Each guest room has an open plan and a generous balcony with impressive views.
Fairmont Gold offers private lounge access, an all-day honor bar, complimentary breakfast and afternoon canapes, and a dedicated concierge.
The 24-hour gym has aerobic machines and strength-training equipment.
The recreation team arranges activities such as golf putting, dragon boat riding on Yun River and kayaking.
The culinary team combines international and local delicacies.
Family suites include a kids' room.

highlights.text: Fairmont Gold guests arrive at the Fairmont Gold wing by an exclusive dragon boat.
The swimming pool is an irregular jade-bottomed pool in the middle of the gardens.
The hotel is surrounded by the Yun River.
The hotel hosts Venetian shows and events.
Rooms are furnished using ancient and modern hardwood and precious natural stone native to the resort in Haitang Bay.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the location is remote and requires transportation to reach Sanya city center.
The Fairmont Gold lounge, honor bar and dragon boat arrival are part of the Fairmont Gold upgrade, not the standard stay.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
